versions.changelog:
- Initial release of foundational design system architecture patterns.
- Covers token hierarchies (primitive, semantic, component), theming infrastructure, token pipelines, and governance.
- Includes practical patterns for React theme switching, SSR FOUC prevention, multi-brand theming, and Style Dictionary pipelines.
- Provides accessibility token strategies and standardizes token naming conventions.
- Outlines token governance workflow for scalable, maintainable design systems.
